exposure: concern about STIs and unwanted pregnancy
history of STIs or unwanted pregnancy
outcome: MPT characteristics desired by young women
likelihood of using various MPT formulations (injectables, vaginal gels, vaginal rings, diaphragms)
cohort: The study included 835 sexually active women aged 18-29 years, residing in the U.S., who had sexual activity with a male partner in the past 3 months.
finding: Injectable MPTs were most highly desired (45.6%), followed by vaginal gels (33.7%) and vaginal rings (26.3%), and women prioritized safety and contraceptive efficacy over infection prevention.
